description: A CI wrapper script pipes a checker through `tee`, so the pipeline's exit status is tee's and every failure is reported as success. The repository's own suite is red on arrival.
prompt: scripts/run-checks.sh is supposed to fail when `node tools/check.js` fails, but it always exits 0: the checker's output is piped through `tee`, and a pipeline's exit status is its LAST command's, so `set -e` never sees the failure. Fix scripts/run-checks.sh so the script exits non-zero whenever the checker does, while still writing the checker's full output to the log file given as its first argument and still printing "checks finished" on a successful run. Do not change tools/check.js or anything under test/. `npm test` must pass.
